spec_match.rationale: Concepts map the SNAP proposal (expired Internet-Draft draft-hancke-tsvwg-snap-00 — work in progress, not an RFC) at the correct layers: the new a=sctp-init media attribute on the UDP/DTLS/SCTP webrtc-datachannel section (inspector probes a real offer for exactly that attribute and reports present/absent), the SCTP portion of the broader createDataChannel→open interval (the latency lab now says its end-to-end timer does not isolate SNAP), and adjacent RTCDataChannel/DCEP options (the reliability concept now states these are not INIT parameters carried by SNAP). SDP offer/answer evidence, SCTP association state, DTLS/ICE transport state, negotiated vs in-band channels, and the RTCDataChannel.protocol label are never conflated.

interactive.rationale: Real RTCPeerConnection loopbacks everywhere: createOffer dissection with highlighted SCTP lines, repeated timed open runs with statistics, and reliability-mode echo channels with negotiated-config readback. No remote signaling server and no fabricated SNAP. Same-page peers still perform local ICE/DTLS/SCTP work; browser WebRTC traffic is not represented as ordinary Fetch/XHR network evidence.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index and ledes match delivered concepts; 'why it shipped' is now 'why acceleration matters' plus an exact availability statement (v151 listing Origin trial; OT desktop 151–156, registerable origin_trial_id 3793719736106221569; detail status 'Proposed' updated 2026-06-30; runtime feature WebRtcSctpSnap experimental; the documented -00 Internet-Draft expired on 2026-07-02 and can be updated, replaced, or abandoned).

edge_cases.rationale: The inspector never infers negotiation from a UI toggle, an SDP substring alone, or an open channel alone: it distinguishes the m=application/UDP-DTLS-SCTP section, the RFC 8841 transport lines, and the SNAP attribute itself, and reports only that the generated offer lacks offer-side SNAP evidence when a=sctp-init is missing. It does not infer later SCTP packet behavior from SDP absence. The latency lab states that its local end-to-end timer includes signalling, ICE, DTLS, SCTP, and DCEP and cannot measure a SNAP-only delta.

references.rationale: All four pages cite ChromeStatus. The index, inspector, and latency lab cite the expired -00 Internet-Draft; the index and inspector cite RFC 8841; the index and reliability concept cite RFC 8831/MDN. The OT stage documentation URL is the same expired draft (origin_trial_id verified in the direct API, updated 2026-06-30).

conformance.rationale: New immutable root suite (this cycle, 8 assertions — 8 JSON entries = 8 rendered rows = 8 reported): both WebRTC interfaces, createDataChannel instance-vs-static binding pair, the RTCDataChannel member surface (protocol/ordered/id/negotiated/maxRetransmits/maxPacketLifeTime), the real loopback-offer SCTP media section, required RFC 8841 sctp-port (without treating optional max-message-size as mandatory), and a direct SNAP a=sctp-init assertion with base64 decoding and a basic SCTP INIT header/length check that fails honestly without the OT/runtime feature. No remote signaling is performed anywhere.

runtime_evidence.rationale: chrome-devtools-mcp on HeadlessChrome/150 (2026-07-24): all visible controls exercised at 1280×800 and 390×844 with post-interaction geometry — real offer generated with m=application + a=sctp-port + a=max-message-size + a=setup + a=fingerprint present and a=sctp-init honestly absent with 'no offer-side SNAP evidence' status, latency runs open channels while disclaiming a SNAP-only measurement, reliability modes echo with per-channel config readback, zero console errors and zero failed requests. Parent review re-counted the revised conformance page as 7 pass / 1 fail / 0 blocked across exactly 8 rows; only direct a=sctp-init evidence fails.

telemetry_health.rationale: Concepts emit showcaseTelemetry.assert events per branch (webrtc-sdp-support/generated/has-sctp, webrtc-openlatency-support/opened, and webrtc-reliability-support/opened); telemetry POSTs returned 202 during validation.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout, button background+color pairs, focus-visible styles, no static-card pattern; edits were copy-level and preserve layout.

accessibility.rationale: role=status/aria-live on status lines and fact panels, the SDP block has an aria-label and tabindex, controls are native keyboard-operable buttons.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Matrix pass including post-interaction states: all four pages scrollWidth equals viewport at 1280×800 and 390×844 after every control (offer generation, latency runs, channel opens); SDP pre scrolls internally only.

openQuestions.title: Verify a=sctp-init and the accelerated open on a WebRtcSctpSnap-enabled build
openQuestions.detail: This build (HeadlessChrome/150, no OT token) generated an offer without a=sctp-init; the later SCTP packet path was not captured. On a build with WebRtcSctpSnap or the origin trial (desktop 151–156, origin_trial_id 3793719736106221569), verify that the offer carries a valid serialized INIT, the supporting answer validates it and returns its own valid serialized INIT (not a mirror of the offer value), and the direct offer-carries-sctp-init assertion passes. Then use an SCTP/DTLS-aware packet or implementation trace plus controlled network conditions to verify the separate SCTP handshake is skipped and measure the delta. The expired -00 procedures may change.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region announcements for dynamic probe/status results after button activation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic state through live regions tied to the activating control; keep programmatic names on status surfaces.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verified applied: status lines and fact panels use role=status/aria-live; the SDP output is a labelled, focusable region.

guidanceConsulted.query: measuring connection establishment latency honestly without faking network conditions
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label measurement contexts and floors honestly; never present local measurements as network-representative.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verified applied: the latency lab now explicitly says its same-page timer is a local end-to-end floor and does not isolate or measure SNAP's proposed saving; controlled enabled-versus-disabled network testing remains required.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: live run statistics across repeated opens

summary: Source-review of the SNAP family against the expired -00 Internet-Draft (a=sctp-init media attribute on UDP/DTLS/SCTP webrtc-datachannel; §5 offer/answer procedures; proposal status), the direct chromestatus detail (updated 2026-06-30: v151 listing Origin trial; OT desktop 151–156, origin_trial_id 3793719736106221569; ship unset, 'Proposed'), the runtime feature WebRtcSctpSnap (experimental, json5 comment explicitly calls it an experimental implementation of the -00 draft), and RFC 8831/8841 for the classic SCTP-over-DTLS negotiation. The family used real loopbacks and present/absent probing, but parent review corrected three material conflations: absence in one offer did not prove the later classic packet path; the end-to-end timer did not isolate SNAP; and per-channel reliability/DCEP fields were not association-level INIT parameters. Hardened status precision: 'why it shipped' renamed 'why acceleration matters' with an exact OT/Proposed/Internet-Draft availability statement, and the inspector gained the OT enablement path (register or --enable-blink-features=WebRtcSctpSnap). Added the immutable root suite; parent review replaced the environment-specific negative with a direct a=sctp-init assertion (7 pass / 1 honest fail here), made the static-binding negative non-vacuous, and stopped requiring optional a=max-message-size. Missing-suite denominator 6→5 expected (793/798).
